Job Description:

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Manager Digital Project (Finance Transformation Manager – Tax) to join Continuous Improvemen t – -Global Finance Services Division
The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore Whitefield Office, KA -India
What you will do
As an integral part of the Continuous Improvement (CI) Center of Excellence, the Finance Transformation Manager – Tax will lead and support global tax transformation initiatives focused on optimization, digitalization, and supporting large efficiencies initiatives.
This role partners closely with Operations Tax, Finance, IT, and GBS stakeholders to modernize tax processes, enable regulatory compliance, improve data quality, and leverage digital solutions across direct and indirect tax domains. The position plays a key role in shaping roadmap-driven transformation aligned with Caterpillar’s global operating model.
Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:
- Lead tax process transformation initiatives across direct and indirect tax areas (e.g., VAT/GST, sales & use tax, withholding tax, corporate income tax reporting).
- Develop current and future state process maps, identify control gaps, automation opportunities, and define measurable improvement outcomes.
- Partner with Tax Ops Leadership and Global Tax stakeholders to understand regulatory requirements, business priorities, and risk areas, translating them into actionable transformation roadmaps.
- Drive digital tax enablement, including process automation, data readiness, ERP integration, tax engines, analytics, and reporting tools.
- Ensure consistent application of CI methodologies, tools, and governance, enabling scalable and sustainable improvements.
- Engage and coordinate cross functional subject matter experts (Tax, Accounting, IT, external advisors) to deliver complex, multi country initiatives.
- Promote a culture of innovation, simplification, and continuous improvement within the tax and finance communities through best practice sharing and hands on leadership.

What you will have
- 6–10 years of overall experience, including 2–3 years in management consulting, tax transformation, or finance transformation roles.
- Strong knowledge of tax processes and operating models, including direct and/or indirect tax compliance, reporting, and controls.
- Experience with process improvement, operating model redesign, or digital transformation within a global or shared services environment.
- Project and program management skills, with the ability to manage complex, multi stakeholder initiatives.
- Demonstrated people leadership or matrix leadership experience.
- Strong diagnostic and analytical capabilities to identify improvement opportunities and design scalable solutions.
- Ability to operate effectively in a global, matrixed environment and influence without direct authority.
- Master’s degree (MSc / MBA) in Business, Finance, Accounting, Tax, or a related discipline.
- Working knowledge of ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle)
- This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the Hosur Facility

Skills desired:

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.
Level Extensive Experience:
• Differentiates assumptions, perspectives, and historical frameworks.
• Evaluates past decisions for insights to improve decision-making process.
• Assesses and validates decision options and points and predicts their potential impact.
• Advises others in analyzing and synthesizing relevant data and assessing alternatives.
• Uses effective decision-making approaches such as consultative, command, or consensus.
• Ensures that assumptions and received wisdom are objectively analyzed in decisions.

Organizational Leadership : Knowledge of leadership concepts and ability to use strategies and skills to enlist others in setting, embracing and achieving objectives.
Level Extensive Experience:
• Employs various group decision-making methods depending on the situation.
• Promotes efficacy through monitoring, coaching & motivating subordinates, intervention, etc.
• Translates vision into specific functional or departmental initiatives.
• Uses emotional contagion to affect the mood of group members, tone of group and group processes.
• Uses a normative decision model (with leadership styles and situational variables) to select style.
• Initiates structure: role clarification, setting standards, holding subordinates accountable, etc.

Program Management (M0260): Knowledge of the policies and techniques to manage a set of related projects within a program; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control the set of projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve program objectives.
Level Extensive Experience:
• Evaluates risks and vulnerabilities, and creates contingency plans.
• Advises others on preferred tools, techniques and methods for estimating program cost and time.
• Conducts regular and ad-hoc program reviews with project managers, team and clients.
• Coaches others in maintaining open communication among project managers and interested parties.
• Oversees reporting requirements, and creates monitoring and control mechanisms.
• Plans, estimates, staffs, organizes and monitors a set of projects within a program.

Change Control : Knowledge of the processes and procedures by which a change is identified, evaluated, approved, monitored and documented; Ability to manage changes in the production environment and processes effectively+
Level Extensive Experience:
• Train others in how to review a proposed change and assesses the potential impact of the change on the organization or environment.
• Manages change control processes to ensure each change is evaluated and dispositioned at the proper authority level.
• Oversees the development of organizational change management policies and procedures.
• Develops and publishes comprehensive change and contingency plans.
• Defines and communicates change risks, contingency alternatives and associated benefits and drawbacks.
• Coordinates the implementation of change in diverse and complex production environments.

IT Project Control and Reporting: Knowledge of project control and reporting; ability to monitor the vital signs of an IT project while managing its progress and delivery schedule.
Level Extensive Experience:
• Justifies varying and appropriate levels of scrutiny for differently experienced team members.
• Advises on the selection of tools and techniques used for monitoring progress and presenting reports to stakeholders.
• Communicates with managerial, technical and business stakeholders on progress reporting.
• Controls multiple IT projects: monitoring progress, probing and repairing delays.
• Consolidates the progress of many IT projects into a single progress report.
• Consults on the principles of Earned Value Analysis across multiple IT projects.

IT Project Management : Knowledge of project management; ability to plan, organize, monitor and control IT projects using appropriate technical resources.
Level Extensive Experience:
• Controls quality standards and budgeting in an ongoing IT project.
• Estimates and appropriately addresses potential issues and risks in IT projects.
• Ensures that technical objectives and functional requirements align in all IT projects.
• Builds IT related templates for demand analysis and functional reports.
• Monitors every step in an IT project to ensure all aspects of the project are delivered on-time.
• Directs team members in analyzing client requirements in an appropriate manner.

IT Standards, Procedures & Policies : Knowledge of Information Technology (IT) standards and policies; ability to utilize a variety of administrative skill sets and technical knowledge to manage organizational IT policies, standards, and procedures.
Level Extensive Experience:
• Evaluates the effectiveness of IT policies through professional group discussions.
• Designs organizational IT policies, standards and procedures.
• Develops templates for designing IT standards and procedures for technical business plans.
• Monitors the implementation of IT standards and procedures in IT projects or services.
• Manages the process for IT standards and procedures delivery and implementation ensuring the organization is under effective management.
• Revises IT policies, standards and procedures based on each department's feedback.

Problem Management: Knowledge of the processes involved in problem control, error control and the production of management information or computer hardware; ability to identify the root cause of problems in a timely and accurate manner and bring them to a successful resolution.
Level Extensive Experience:
• Monitors and improves problem reporting, tracking, escalation and resolution.
• Estimates costs and benefits of potential solutions and makes recommendations.
• Receives, clarifies and resolves a variety of standard and atypical problems.
• Conducts trend and root cause analysis to identify and address recurring problems.
• Coaches junior staff on handling a variety of service related problems.
• Identifies and evaluates alternative approaches to resolving service problems.
What you will get:
- Work Life Harmony
- Earned and medical leave.
- Relocation assistance

Holistic Development
- Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe
- Career developments opportunities with global prospects

Health and Wellness
- Medical coverage -Medical, life and personal accident coverage
- Employee mental wellness assistance program

Financial Wellness
- Employee investment plan
- Pay for performance -Annual incentive Bonus plan.

Additional Information:
Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at www.caterpillar.com/careers

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

jobs.title: Business Strategy Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Career Area:
Strategy
Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other.  We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

The Business Strategy Senior Manager leads the development of enterprise growth strategies addressing Caterpillar's most important markets, customer segments, products, services, and business opportunities. This role leads high-impact strategy engagements for the C-Suite and senior leadership, converting complex market and business questions into clear choices, actionable recommendations, and measurable pathways to growth.

The Senior Manager leads internal strategy teams, shapes the Enterprise Strategy portfolio, and serves as a senior thought partner to Caterpillar leaders. The role requires exceptional problem-solving ability, strong commercial and financial judgment, and the capacity to influence enterprise direction across organizational boundaries.

What You Will Do:
- Lead enterprise strategy engagements focused on long-term profitable growth, portfolio choices, market attractiveness, customer segments, products, services, business models, and geographic opportunities.
- Frame ambiguous business questions using hypothesis-driven problem solving and translate them into structured, decision-oriented workplans.
- Develop high-quality strategic options and recommendations supported by rigorous qualitative and quantitative analysis.
- Lead assessments of market structure, customer needs, competitive dynamics, economic value, capability requirements, and potential sources of differentiation.
- Build business cases and financial models that evaluate growth potential, investment requirements, risks, returns, and strategic alternatives.
- Lead cross-functional teams drawing on internal Caterpillar expertise, third-party research, external expert interviews, and primary market insights.
- Advise executive sponsors on strategic choices, key uncertainties, implementation considerations, and potential organizational implications.
- Present recommendations to senior leadership and facilitate alignment around critical decisions.
- Establish strong working relationships with Caterpillar business units and enterprise functions while maintaining an objective enterprise perspective.
- Identify emerging growth opportunities and strategic issues that should be elevated to the enterprise agenda.
- Develop the capabilities of strategy managers and consultants through coaching, feedback, and hands-on leadership.
- Contribute to the continuing development of Caterpillar's enterprise strategy processes, methodologies, knowledge base, and talent pipeline.
- Voice and challenge strategic concerns constructively when evidence or enterprise interests require a different perspective.

What You Have:
- Education and Experience: Bachelor's degree, preferably in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, or a related discipline; typically 10 or more years of progressive experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, finance, business development, operations, or a related field.
- Strategy Development: Extensive experience structuring complex strategic questions, developing alternatives, and translating analysis into actionable recommendations.
- Business and Financial Acumen: Strong understanding of markets, business models, competitive advantage, corporate finance, and the drivers of profitable growth.
- Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead high-performing teams through complex, ambiguous, and highly visible assignments.
- Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to manage executive sponsors, understand competing perspectives, and build alignment across functions and business units.
- Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Ability to integrate incomplete or conflicting information, test assumptions, and make sound recommendations based on informed judgment.
- Effective Communication: Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate with senior executives in a concise and compelling manner.
- Consulting: Advanced knowledge of consulting methods, project leadership, executive problem solving, and client engagement.

What Will Set You Apart:
- MBA or comparable advanced degree from a leading program.
- Leadership experience at a recognized strategy consulting firm, investment bank, corporate development team, or high-performing corporate strategy organization.
- Experience developing strategies for industrial, heavy-equipment, automotive, energy, technology, or other asset-intensive businesses.
- Experience evaluating new businesses, market entry opportunities, partnerships, acquisitions, or major organic investments.
- Advanced financial modeling, PowerPoint, Excel, and data-visualization capabilities.
- Demonstrated success influencing C-Suite decisions and enterprise resource allocation.
- Ability to combine fact-based analysis with practical understanding of organizational implementation.

Additional Information:
- 25% travel is expected.

Summary Pay Range:

$172,630.00 - $258,950.00
Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. Please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Caterpillar.

Benefits:
Subject to plan eligibility, terms, and guidelines. This is a summary list of benefits.
- Medical, dental, and vision benefits*

- Paid time off plan (Vacation, Holidays, Volunteer, etc.)*

- 401(k) savings plans*

- Health Savings Account (HSA)*

- Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)*

- Health Lifestyle Programs*

- Employee Assistance Program*

- Voluntary Benefits and Employee Discounts*

- Career Development*

- Incentive bonus*

- Disability benefits

- Life Insurance

- Parental leave

- Adoption benefits

- Tuition Reimbursement

* These benefits also apply to part-time employees

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Relocation is available for this position.

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Posting Dates:
October 8, 2026 - October 21, 2026
Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen.

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer, Including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities.  Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply.

jobs.description:
Career Area:
Strategy
Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other.  We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

The Technology Strategy Senior Manager leads the development of enterprise strategies at the intersection of technology, business, and growth with particular focus on artificial intelligence (AI), robotics, sensing technologies, and application development. This role helps Caterpillar determine where technology can create differentiated customer value, strengthen the company's competitive position, enable new products and services, and improve the performance of its businesses.

The Senior Manager evaluates emerging technologies, evolving industry structures, ecosystem dynamics, and potential disruptions. Working across Caterpillar's businesses and technology organizations, the role converts complex technical developments into clear enterprise choices, investment priorities, and actionable strategic roadmaps.

What You Will Do:
- Lead enterprise technology strategy engagements addressing opportunities and disruptions with potential to materially affect Caterpillar's businesses and customers.
- Develop enterprise-level strategic perspectives and roadmaps for AI, robotics, sensing technologies, and application development.
- Translate emerging technology developments into clear business implications, strategic choices, and executive-level recommendations.
- Assess technologies, platforms, use cases, business models, market maturity, adoption barriers, ecosystem structures, and potential sources of competitive advantage.
- Develop strategic roadmaps that connect customer needs and enterprise growth priorities with technology capabilities, investments, partnerships, and delivery pathways.
- Evaluate build, buy, partner, and invest options based on strategic fit, economic value, speed, capability requirements, and long-term differentiation.
- Identify opportunities for technology-enabled products, services, customer experiences, and new business models.
- Partner with Caterpillar business units, Digital, Information Technology, engineering, advanced research, corporate development, and other enterprise functions.
- Develop business cases and investment theses that quantify market potential, customer value, financial impact, capability requirements, and execution risk.
- Lead external market research, technology scouting, expert interviews, competitor assessments, and ecosystem analysis.
- Establish fact-based perspectives on technology trends, separating durable strategic shifts from short-term market activity.
- Present recommendations to senior leadership and facilitate alignment around critical technology choices and investment priorities.
- Develop early-warning perspectives on technologies or non-traditional competitors that could disrupt Caterpillar's products, channels, customer relationships, or sources of competitive advantage.
- Lead and develop multidisciplinary teams that combine strategy, commercial, technical, financial, and operational expertise.
- Build reusable technology strategy methodologies, external networks, and knowledge assets for the Enterprise Strategy team.

What You Have:
- Education and Experience: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline; typically 10 or more years of progressive experience in technology strategy, corporate strategy, management consulting, product strategy, digital transformation, engineering leadership, venture investing, or a related field.
- Priority Technology Domains : Strong working knowledge of AI, robotics, sensing technologies, and application development, including the ability to assess relevant use cases, ecosystems, business models, and strategic implications.
- Technology and Business Acumen: Ability to understand complex technologies and evaluate their potential commercial, operational, and competitive implications.
- Strategy Development: Extensive experience structuring ambiguous questions, evaluating strategic alternatives, and creating actionable roadmaps.
- Financial and Commercial Analysis: Ability to evaluate markets, business models, investments, partnerships, and technology-enabled growth opportunities.
- Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams that include business, engineering, digital, financial, and operational stakeholders.
- Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to engage senior leaders, reconcile differing technical and commercial perspectives, and build alignment around enterprise choices.
- Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Ability to assess emerging areas where available information may be incomplete, uncertain, or rapidly evolving.
- Effective Communication: Exceptional ability to explain complex technology topics in clear business language and communicate recommendations to executive audiences.

What Will Set You Apart:
- MBA, master's degree, or doctorate in a relevant business or technical discipline.
- Experience at a recognized strategy consulting firm, technology company, industrial corporation, venture capital firm, or corporate strategy organization.
- Experience developing strategies involving industrial technology, autonomy, robotics, artificial intelligence, connected assets, advanced analytics, digital platforms, energy systems, or software-enabled services.
- Experience assessing technology partnerships, acquisitions, venture investments, or new-business opportunities.
- Strong understanding of industrial customers, workflows, channels, and asset-intensive operating environments.
- Demonstrated ability to connect technology investments to customer value, business economics, and sustainable competitive advantage.
- Strong external network across technology companies, research organizations, investors, industry experts, and potential ecosystem partners.

Additional Details:
- 25% travel is expected.

$159,120.00 - $238,680.00

The Finance Transformation Lead is managing the Continuous Improvement and Automation Analytics Center of Excellence (ACOE) team and is responsible for identifying, shaping, and delivering strategic finance transformation initiatives across the Analytics Center of Excellence towers.
This role serves as the bridge between Finance, Data & Analytics, Digital Technology, and Business Operations, leveraging advanced analytics, automation, AI, and process redesign to improve operational performance, strengthen controls, enhance decision-making, and deliver measurable business value.
The successful candidate acts as an internal consultant and trusted advisor, partnering with finance leaders to redesign processes, build scalable digital solutions, and accelerate the adoption of innovative technologies across the enterprise. The position requires strong business acumen, analytical thinking, stakeholder influence, and the ability to lead complex cross-functional transformation initiatives from concept through value realization.

Finance Transformation Leadership
- Lead end-to-end finance transformation initiatives across Analytics Center of Excellence towers
- Identify process improvement opportunities through analytics, benchmarking, process mining, operational reviews, and stakeholder engagement.
- Design future-state operating models focused on simplification, standardization, automation, and elimination of non-value-added activities.
- Develop business cases, investment proposals, implementation roadmaps, and value realization plans.
- Drive adoption of best-in-class finance processes and digital capabilities across the organization.
- Act as a transformation lead for strategic initiatives involving ERP optimization, workflow automation, AI, machine learning, and intelligent process automation.

Analytics & Digital Enablement
- Translate business challenges into analytical, automation, and technology solutions.
- Partner with data engineering, analytics, and technology teams to define requirements and deliver scalable solutions.
- Promote the use of advanced analytics, predictive intelligence, AI-enabled insights, and Agentic AI capabilities to improve finance processes and decision making.
- Guide development of dashboards, KPI frameworks, executive reporting, and self-service analytics solutions.
- Ensure strong governance over data quality, metric definitions, business rules, and reporting standards.

AI and Intelligent Automation
- Lead identification and implementation of emerging technologies, including Generative AI, Agentic AI, Intelligent Document Processing, and workflow automation.
- Evaluate automation opportunities based on business value, control requirements, scalability, and operational risk.
- Partner with IT and Digital teams to develop sustainable and controlled automation solutions.
- Establish governance and measurement frameworks to ensure successful adoption and business value realization.

Strategic Stakeholder Management
- Serve as a trusted advisor to Finance Leadership, Global Business Services, Analytics Center of Excellence teams, and Technology organizations.
- Facilitate executive workshops, process design sessions, and transformation reviews.
- Influence decision making in complex matrix organizations without direct authority.
- Communicate recommendations, project status, risks, and expected business outcomes to senior leadership.

Program Delivery & Governance
- Ensure disciplined project execution through structured governance, issue management, benefit tracking, and risk mitigation.
- Monitor project performance and value realization against approved business cases.
- Drive adherence to controls, compliance, audit, and data governance requirements.
- Support project prioritization and portfolio management activities across the Analytics COE.

Capability Building & Leadership
- Provide coaching, mentoring, and functional leadership to continuous improvement team members , transformation consultants, and project resources.
- Contribute to the development of Analytics COE methodologies, standards, and best practices.
- Promote a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision making.
- Build organizational capability in analytics, digital technologies, automation, and AI adoption.

- Finance Transformation

- Digital Transformation
- Finance Systems
- Strong understanding of end-to-end finance processes and operating models.
- Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide transformation initiatives.

About The Role:
The Marine Digital Services Strategy Manager acts as the global strategy and business owner for Marine digital solutions across relevant marine industry segments. The role utilizes their deep expertise and experience with Caterpillar data systems, telematics, and business intelligence products to partner closely with the marine strategy team, product and commercial teams, Cat dealers, Digital, IT, aftermarket, service, data, cybersecurity, legal, compliance, enterprise digital teams, and division process partners to prioritize, govern, and deploy digital opportunities that solve customer challenges and create differentiated value.

What You Will Do:
- Develops, maintains, and communicates the global Caterpillar Marine digital strategy, ensuring linkage to marine strategy, COGMD priorities, enterprise digital roadmaps, dealer value proposition, customer lifecycle needs, and growth objectives.
- Provides business ownership for the Caterpillar Marine portfolio of digital solutions, including portfolio prioritization, value proposition definition, roadmap governance, lifecycle decisions, and stewardship of the MGPP in alignment with enterprise and division process partners.
- Converts customer, dealer, industry, regulatory, segment, and competitive inputs into digital priorities, use cases, business cases, deployment roadmaps, and investment recommendations.
- Evaluates enterprise technologies and external digital solutions for marine applicability, including connected assets, remote monitoring, analytics, predictive maintenance, fleet visibility, lifecycle optimization, service enablement, and customer experience capabilities.
- Leads cross-functional stakeholder alignment, governance preparation, executive communications, and decision support for digital initiatives across the marine business unit.
- Identifies inorganic opportunities, including partnerships, alliances, acquisitions, investments, technology licensing, and ecosystem plays that could accelerate execution or close capability gaps.
- Monitors adoption, market feedback, dealer readiness, customer value realization, and portfolio performance to refine the roadmap and recommend strategic pivots.

Key Digital Strategy Focus Areas
- Customer and dealer-facing digital services that improve uptime, visibility, utilization, maintenance planning, operational efficiency, and lifecycle value.
- Digitally supported commercial and aftermarket growth models, including service growth, customer value agreements, dealer-enabled workflows, and parts and service pull-through.
- Fleet, equipment, and customer data strategy requirements, including mixed fleets, ship-to-shore models, analytics, reporting, and decision support.
- Marine-specific digital standards, data governance, cybersecurity, regulatory, compliance, and interoperability requirements.
- Competitive, ecosystem, and inorganic opportunities across OEMs, marine technology providers, digital fleet platforms, connectivity providers, analytics companies, and systems integrators.

Core Competencies
- Business acumen: Builds customer-backed digital strategies, business cases, and investment recommendations using market, financial, operational, dealer, and customer inputs.
- Strategic planning: Directs development, maintenance, communication, and governance of the marine digital strategy, portfolio roadmap, and MGPP.
- Strategic thinking: Maintains a big-picture view of digital opportunities, risks, partnerships, inorganic pathways, and competitive dynamics across marine segments.
- Digital solution strategy: Evaluates digital technologies, data platforms, connectivity, analytics, and customer workflows for marine applicability and scalable execution.
- Stakeholder management: Builds alignment across marine, dealers, customers, enterprise digital, product, commercial, aftermarket, service, legal, compliance, cybersecurity, and process partner organizations.
- Data gathering and benchmarking: Oversees market intelligence, voice-of-customer input, dealer feedback, competitive analysis, standards monitoring, and digital trend reporting.

What You Will Have:
- Customer Focus: Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
- Data Gathering & Analysis: Knowledge of data gathering and analysis tools, techniques, and processes; ability to collect and synthesize data from a variety of stakeholders and sources in an objective manner to reach a conclusion, goal, or judgment.
- Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
- Relationship Management: Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers .
- Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Typical Qualifications
- Degree or equivalent experience desired; advanced degree in business, strategy, engineering, technology, digital, data, or related field preferred.
- Significant experience in strategy development, digital product or solution strategy, business development, consulting, commercial strategy, product management, program management, or technology-enabled service models.
- Strong understanding of marine customer operations, dealer channels, aftermarket value creation, enterprise digital capabilities, connected assets, data platforms, analytics, customer-facing applications, cybersecurity, compliance, and technology partnerships preferred.
- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional strategy work, influence without direct authority, prioritize portfolio choices, and translate complex market and technology inputs into executive-ready recommendations.
- Global perspective and ability to operate across regions, cultures, marine segments, dealers, customers, and enterprise stakeholder groups.

Success Measures
- Enterprise-aligned Caterpillar Marine digital strategy, roadmap, and MGPP adopted by key stakeholders.
- Effective business ownership of the Marine digital solutions portfolio, with clear prioritization, governance, value propositions, and lifecycle decisions.
- Validated customer and dealer-backed use cases with prioritized business cases and execution pathways.
- Improved visibility to market trends, standards, competitive digital capabilities, emerging customer requirements, and inorganic acceleration opportunities.
- Digital initiatives linked to measurable customer value, dealer enablement, aftermarket and OE growth, operational efficiency, and marine strategy outcomes.

$128,470.00 - $192,710.00

Job Summary
Caterpillar is seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead the integrated delivery of a greenfield smart manufacturing facility in Sanford, North Carolina. This highly visible leadership role will oversee a complex enterprise program consisting of seven interconnected workstreams: Building and Facility; Manufacturing Process Design; Procurement and Supplier Diversity; Information Technology and Operational Technology Systems; People Transformation; Commissioning and Startup Readiness; and New Source Introduction.

This senior staff leader will serve as the strategic integrator and “chief of staff” for the program, connecting executive direction, cross-functional execution, organizational readiness, and program governance. Working across business and functional leaders, Human Resources, Communications, suppliers, and contractors, this leader will drive alignment, enable timely decisions, and provide an objective assessment of overall program health.

What You Will Do

- Manage and align seven program workstreams, coordinating scope, budget, schedule, risks, dependencies, resources, decisions, and key deliverables. Workstreams include:

- Integrate information across all workstreams, translate executive direction into coordinated action, prepare leaders for key decisions, and ensure decisions and commitments are carried through execution.

- Monitor program budget performance, forecast resource requirements, assess variances, and support informed investment decisions.

- Lead and develop program and project management professionals while fostering collaboration across teams and functions.

- Own the integrated view of program health across scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, organizational readiness, dependencies, and emerging risks. Provide leaders with timely, objective assessments and recommended actions.

- Drive commissioning, production ramp-up, workforce preparedness, supplier readiness, and operational handoff activities.

- Lead the integrated change management approach across all workstreams, partnering with Human Resources and Communications to align leaders, assess stakeholder impacts, build organizational readiness, coordinate messaging, and support adoption of new ways of working.

- Lead the program communication strategy, ensuring consistent, timely, and audience-appropriate communication to executive leaders, workstream teams, employees, and key stakeholders across the organization.

What You Will Have

Strategic Leadership and Integration: Ability to connect enterprise strategy to execution, align leaders and workstreams around shared outcomes, and advise senior stakeholders with an objective, organization-wide perspective.

Program Management and Prioritization: Knowledge of program planning, governance, execution, controls, and methods for organizing and prioritizing work; ability to coordinate complex workstreams, manage dependencies and competing demands, and maintain progress against key deliverables through structured program leadership.

Program Governance and Controls : Knowledge of decision rights, operating rhythms, controls, escalation methods, and accountability practices; ability to create transparency, drive timely resolution, and ensure commitments are completed.

Enterprise Change Management: Knowledge of stakeholder impact, readiness, adoption, and organizational change practices; ability to partner across Human Resources, Communications, and business to coordinate change across a complex program.

Collaboration and Influence: Ability to build trust, navigate competing perspectives, and align leaders and teams around shared program outcomes.
Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of tools and techniques for making effective decisions; ability to analyze complex information, evaluate alternatives, and take timely action.

Risk Management: Knowledge of processes for identifying, assessing, mitigating, and monitoring risks; ability to protect program outcomes related to safety, quality, cost, schedule, and readiness.

- Bachelor’s degree and/or Project Management Professional, Program Management Professional, Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, or comparable certification.

- Experience leading large-scale, complex programs involving multiple interconnected projects, functions, stakeholders, and delivery teams.

- Strong capabilities in program governance, controls, integrated planning, change management, scheduling, risk management, and execution, including experience establishing decision forums, operating rhythms, and escalation processes.

- Demonstrated experience managing significant budgets, forecasts, resource plans, and financial performance.

- Proven ability to influence senior leaders and stakeholders without relying solely on direct authority.

- Strong decision-making and critical-thinking skills in complex business environments.

- Experience managing competing priorities, resolving conflict, and leading cross-functional teams.

- Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior strategic advisor and integrator, connect strategy to execution, challenge assumptions, and provide an objective assessment of overall program health and risk.

- Clear executive communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex program information into concise messages and communicate effectively up, down, and across the organization.

What You Will Get
This role offers the opportunity to shape a significant manufacturing investment from development through startup. You will have broad visibility across business and functional leadership, influence decisions that affect program execution and organizational readiness, and help build the next generation of connected, digitally enabled manufacturing operations.

Job Summary
The Manufacturing IT Operations Manager will be accountable for IT partnership with Operations, internal Caterpillar IT teams and service providers to support the startup of a new advanced manufacturing facility in Sanford, North Carolina. This leader will align infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, edge, network, data, application, and support-model decisions to Caterpillar enterprise standards and the requirements of a complex manufacturing environment.

Smart manufacturing is an important part of the context, but the core of the role is partnering with Operations, coordinating Caterpillar IT teams, service providers, vendors, and project stakeholders to successfully deliver, operationalize, and support the facility. The role is accountable for ensuring the right resources are engaged, decisions are made in a timely manner, risks are addressed, and the site is ready to operate and support manufacturing at launch and beyond.

What You Will Do
- Coordinate Caterpillar IT teams, architects, service providers, and technical specialists to ensure technology solutions align with enterprise standards, business priorities, and long-term operating needs.

- Navigate Caterpillar’s enterprise technology, manufacturing, cybersecurity, infrastructure, application, vendor, and site teams to bring the right expertise to the table at the right time.

- Support smart manufacturing priorities by enabling capabilities such as connected equipment, automation, production visibility, industrial data, analytics, and manufacturing systems through the effective deployment of supporting technology platforms and infrastructure.

- Facilitate alignment across information technology and operational technology teams so requirements, dependencies, ownership, cybersecurity, supportability, and implementation risks are understood early.

- Translate business and manufacturing needs into implementation plans, operational priorities, support models, and delivery activities that enable successful facility launch and sustained operations.

- Ensure appropriate architecture reviews, governance processes, support models, documentation, training, and operational standards are established through the relevant Caterpillar IT teams and technical specialists.
- Evaluate technology platforms and vendors by balancing business value, technical feasibility, cybersecurity, safety, scalability, implementation risk, and total cost of ownership.

- Develop roadmaps that sequence foundational capabilities, reduce technology debt, and move solutions from pilots to reliable operations.

- Lead the transition from project delivery to operational support by establishing support models, defining ownership, driving knowledge transfer, managing service providers, and ensuring the facility has the capabilities required for long-term operation.

Technology leadership : Experience leading complex IT programs, manufacturing technology deployments, site start-ups, or large-scale business transformations involving multiple teams, vendors, and stakeholders.

Strategic thinking : Ability to translate manufacturing and business outcomes into architecture decisions, trade-offs, dependencies, risks, and long-term implications.

Technical leadership: Ability to guide multidisciplinary teams toward secure, scalable, supportable, and practical solutions.

Partnership and communication: Ability to influence business leaders, manufacturing stakeholders, engineers, technology teams, vendors, and systems integrators while navigating a large enterprise and explaining technical trade-offs clearly.

People and change leadership: Experience managing, coaching, mentoring, or directing technical professionals and helping stakeholders adopt new standards, platforms, and ways of working.

You will influence foundational technology decisions for a new Caterpillar manufacturing environment by shaping the infrastructure architecture, governance, standards, and partnerships needed for successful launch and long-term operations. This role is more than technical design; it requires knowing how to work across Caterpillar, connect the right experts, clarify decision ownership, and turn complex requirements into practical solutions.  Smart manufacturing will be part of the environment, but the strongest candidates will be technology leaders who can build alignment across teams, manage trade-offs, coordinate delivery, and deliver reliable operational outcomes. About IPSD

Caterpillar’s Industrial Power Systems Division (IPSD) designs, tests and manufactures 0.5 to 18L Cat® and Perkins engines that power over 5000 applications including Marine, Petroleum, Industrial Applications, Electric Generators, and Locomotives. Caterpillar’s company strategy includes sustainability as one of four focus areas and IPSD is engaged and actively preparing green energy solutions for the future.

Job Summary

An exciting opportunity to lead the Perkins Engines Peterborough and Birchwood Aftermarket Imports Team, with overall responsibility for the import operations and customs compliance procedures associated with goods imported into the UK.
This role is critical to ensuring the compliant, efficient, and timely importation of goods, supporting supply chain continuity and the fulfilment of customer demand. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving operational excellence through the continuous improvement of import processes, ensuring goods are customs cleared and delivered to designated customs warehouses in a compliant, efficient, and timely manner. The position also has overall accountability for the management and oversight of customs operational and compliance activities, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements and internal governance standards. This includes monitoring compliance performance, mitigating customs risks, and supporting audit readiness across the import function
Leveraging specialist expertise in customs and international trade, the manager will provide leadership and guidance to the team in the planning, development, implementation, and operation of systems and processes that ensure:

- Accurate declaration and payment of customs duties and taxes.

- Effective management of customs authorisation regimes, including Inward Processing (IP) and Customs Warehousing (CW).

- Continuous enhancement of customs controls, compliance procedures, and operational efficiency.

- Alignment with evolving customs legislation, government requirements, and corporate compliance standards.

Additional Info

- Limited domestic travel required (10% of working time).

What You Will Do

- Lead and manage Perkins' Inward Processing (IP), Customs Warehousing (CW), and Simplified Customs Declaration Procedures (SCDP) authorisations, ensuring full compliance with UK customs legislation.

- Oversee import customs operations, including customs declaration management, customs broker governance, and performance management.

- Develop and enhance customs policies, procedures, controls, standard work, and audit programmes to meet regulatory, business, and corporate requirements.

- Manage the company's customs deferment account and support customs-related financial reporting and controls.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for customs compliance, providing guidance on import regulations, tariff classification, customs valuation, origin, and duty relief regimes.

- Partner with divisional and enterprise trade compliance teams to support strategic business initiatives impacted by international trade regulations.

- Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across Supply Chain, Logistics, Purchasing, Engineering, and Finance to ensure compliance and operational alignment.

- Monitor regulatory developments and implement changes to customs processes, controls, and business practices as required.

- Drive a culture of continuous improvement, compliance awareness, and capability development through coaching, training, and process optimisation initiatives.

- Ensure accurate customs record-keeping and audit readiness through effective management of customs documentation and compliance reporting.

- Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, strengthen compliance controls, and maximise duty recovery through Lean and continuous improvement methodologies.

- Manage relationships with customs brokers, suppliers, carriers, freight forwarders, and logistics providers to support the efficient movement of goods.

- Oversee customs-related insurance claims and support risk management activities where applicable.

- Lead, develop, and motivate the Imports Team, managing performance through KPIs, compliance metrics, workload planning, and continuous improvement initiatives.

What You Have

- Proven experience in customs compliance, import operations, and customs authorisation regimes, including Customs Warehousing and Inward Processing.

- Strong working knowledge of UK customs regulations, including customs classification, customs valuation, origin requirements, and duty relief regimes.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to clearly articulate compliance requirements and influence decision-making across all levels of the organisation.

- Strong analytical and data management skills, with the ability to gather, interpret, and present complex data to support operational and compliance decisions. Experience with data analytics tools is advantageous.

- Proven problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to identify root causes, assess risks, and implement effective, sustainable solutions.

- Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to contribute to operational, tactical, and strategic business objectives.

- Demonstrated decision-making and critical thinking skills, enabling sound judgement in complex or time-sensitive situations.

- Experience using ERP and customs systems, including SAP, QAD EE, Customs Duty Management systems, and the UK Customs Declaration Service (CDS).

- Previous people management experience, including performance management, coaching, talent development, and driving improvements in team and business performance.

- Relevant customs, international trade, or compliance qualifications from a recognised professional body are highly desirable.

What You Will Get

- The opportunity to work for a diverse, world-class business with a competitive salary and additional benefits and the opportunity to work flexibly.

- Lead a key operational customs team that supports the success of the Perkins Engines and Aftermarket businesses, partnering across functions to drive operational excellence and profitable growth.

- Join a collaborative customs organisation undergoing an exciting transformation, with opportunities to shape future processes, build cross-functional partnerships, expand your professional network, and further develop your leadership and customs expertise.

About Caterpillar

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

Caterpillar's Electric Power Division (EPD) offers integrated solutions, parts, and services to meet the needs of our various commercial and industrial electric power customers. EPD supports a wide range of customer applications across the globe, including providing back-up power to hospitals, providing emergency power when natural disasters strike, and supporting critical infrastructure for data centers, municipalities, and more. With a rich history of more than 95 years in the electric power business, our team has world-class expertise and a proven ability to adapt to changing demands. We’re committed to providing sustainable and reliable solutions to our customers. Join our team to help build a better, more sustainable world for future generations!

Job Summary:
As a Business Development Manager in the Electric Power Division, you will be out in front of the industry working directly with our end use customers to understand their needs, propose solutions to challenges they didn’t anticipate and develop energy outcomes to serve their future power needs. In this role, you will be responsible for driving incremental volume in the prime power generation space. Whether it’s CHP (Combined Heat and Power), Utility Capacity (Bridge to Grid), Biogas, Mine Site Electrification or another industry that needs reliable power, you will be there to support and fuel the growth.

What You Will Do: ​
- Engage with our customers to develop integrated customer offerings, anticipating and meeting their energy needs
- Grow relationships with key accounts to secure long term agreements on generator set demand
- Have a direct relationship with large key consulting engineers and EPCs.
- Develop professional network both internally and externally.
- Develop awareness of commercial aspects of procurement to help make strategic sourcing recommendations in support of the cost, quality, and velocity objectives of the commodity.
- Develop skills to build long-term external relationships with customers as well as internal relationships with business unit customers are also expected.
- Leverage on knowledge of others, develops and nurtures strategic relationships with end customers.
- Develop and secure Customer Value Agreement growth with all customer solutions.
- Deliver business plan and market share targets for the company products in a given industry segment or market.

What You Have:
Customer Focus: Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
- Significant progressive job-related experience – within the Power Generation or Oil & Gas/Mining industries with a focus on transitioning to electrified solutions.
- Facilitates creation of the 'right' products and services to resolve customer business issues.
- Fosters strong customer relationships via delivery on commitments, open communication, and on-going feedback/improvement.
- Anticipates customer needs, focusing efforts to proactively meet needs and exceed customer expectations.

Industry Knowledge: Knowledge of the organization's industry group, trends, directions, major issues, regulatory considerations, and trendsetters; ability to apply industry knowledge appropriately to diverse situations.
- Familiar with switchgear, power generation, reciprocating gas and diesel engines, battery energy storage systems (BESS), PV and microgrids.
- Connections with industry consultants & EPCs
- Advises colleagues on implementation and operational considerations.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.
- Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process.
- Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.

Effective Communications : Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
- Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
- Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
- Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Negotiating: Knowledge of successful negotiation concepts and techniques; ability to negotiate successfully across the organization and with external vendors and clients in a constructive and collaborative manner.
- Protects own position, while demonstrating willingness to achieve win-win.
- Identifies similarities and differences in position and assesses impact on discussions.

Relationship Management: Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers.
- Communicates to clients regarding expectations of all parties.
- Participates in negotiating the terms of the business relationship.
- Maintains productive, long-term relationships with clients or vendors.
- Creates opportunities to educate support teams on client priorities.

Account Management: Knowledge of account management; ability to manage day-to-day activities, providing services and support to existing clients.
- Analyzes the sales history and current activity for a specific account.
- Coordinates with internal support functions to meet unique client needs.
- Provides account management support to a specific customer or account.

Value Selling: Knowledge of the principles and practices for selling products, technology and services; ability to provide overall product/service 'value' and to differentiate support offerings that address clearly understood customer needs.
- Acquires and retains customers in multiple settings using 'value selling' techniques.
- Coaches others on the application of 'value selling' principles and practices.
- Delivers value-added services to customers beyond delivery of a purchased product, technology or service consistently.

Top candidates will have:
- Proven leadership skills and ability to sell ideas
- Effective Influencing tactics and strategies
- Experience working in power generation space

Additional Info: ​
- This role requires travelling up to 75% of the time within Australia & Pacific Islands, occasionally travel will be required outside of region.
- This position requires working onsite five days a week.

About Integrated Drivetrain

Our global Integrated Drivetrain Energy Solutions (IDES) team combines proven drivetrain capabilities with emerging electrification and energy technologies to help customers solve their toughest challenges across a changing energy landscape. Our global team enables us to share expertise while scaling and accelerating innovation. While the Integrated Drivetrain team delivers reliable products at scale, our Energy Solutions team works closely with customers to develop site-specific solutions and innovations to meet complex customer needs. Each segment of the business brings distinct expertise and ways of working, but together we strengthen what customers rely on today while developing the solutions they will need tomorrow.
You will be part of the dynamic, cross-functional IDES HR Team that leverages the unique strengths of every individual. We are looking for self-driven, agile, collaborative people who thrive in fast-paced environments and are eager to explore, experiment and deliver. This leadership role is responsible for ensuring product availability, inventory effectiveness, supplier performance, forecasting accuracy, and operational excellence while serving as a critical link between commercial teams, suppliers, production scheduling, and operations.

You will lead a team of Production Schedulers and partner closely with Product Support and Logistics Distribution (PSLD), suppliers, manufacturing operations, and commercial teams to align demand forecasts with supply plans, increase supply availability, and drive lean forecasting processes that support business growth and customer commitments.

- Work with suppliers to ensure adequate material and product availability while proactively addressing capacity, supply, and delivery risks.
- Serve as the key liaison connecting BCP operations, PSLD, suppliers, and other supply chain functions to ensure seamless execution.
- Drive continuous improvements in forecasting accuracy, inventory performance, and material stocking strategies.
- Monitor supply chain performance and establish corrective actions, including reviewing open issues and supply disruptions within established response timelines.

·       Supply Chain Management - MFG: Knowledge of functions, principles and techniques used in supply chain management; ability to develop and use, strategies, practices and tools for controlling the logistical processes.
·       Cross-Team Integration: Understanding of the importance of inter-team collaboration in breaking down silos and achieving business results; ability to lead employees from various functions to communicate, coordinate work across divisions, and collaborate in solving problems as one team.
·       Planning and Organizing: Knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way.
·       Process Improvement: Understanding and insight into evaluating current product quality and production methods and ability to maintains focus on the continuous improvement of processes, products and services.

·       Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Operations Management, Engineering, Business, Logistics, or related field.
·       8+ years of progressive supply chain, planning, operations, manufacturing, or logistics leadership experience.

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

Through Cat Technology, we are solving problems by building the intelligence layer that connects machines, data, and people to make jobsites safer, more productive, and more sustainable. The result will be a new generation of machines that continuously learn, improve, and deliver performance at scale.
Be Part of What’s Next in Autonomous Construction Sites
Construction autonomy is one of the most complex challenges in applied AI, and at Caterpillar, advancements in physical AI, simulation, sensing, and edge computing are turning things that once felt impossible—intelligent machines operating in dynamic jobsites—into reality.
Our connected ecosystem brings together massive volumes of high-quality data to create a foundation where engineers like you can build and deploy against.
If this work motivates you, we invite you to join our team. In these roles, you’ll work at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. You’ll help design and deliver intelligent systems that enable machines to perceive their environment, make informed decisions, and support safer, more productive operations.
Apply today to build the new era of construction autonomy at Caterpillar.
Job Summary:
The Portfolio Operations & Governance Lead operates the control discipline that turns portfolio meetings, risks, decisions, dependencies, actions, and evidence into accountable follow-through and closure. This role makes the Portfolio operating system usable day to day by maintaining governance records, preparing decision forums, surfacing overdue or incomplete controls, and ensuring approved decisions and changes are traceable across Atlas and the broader CI portfolio.

What You Will Do:
- Operate integrated risk, issue, dependency, action, decision, and reconciliation registers, ensuring each item has clear ownership, timing, status, evidence, and disposition.
- Prepare Portfolio and cross-mission forums by confirming required inputs, decision questions, pre-reads, evidence, attendees, and escalation paths.
- Record decisions, actions, dependencies, and change dispositions during or immediately after forums; publish outcomes and track closure.
- Monitor aging, overdue checkpoints, missing owners, incomplete mitigations, unresolved dependencies, and stale records; escalate control failures through the agreed path.
- Administer controlled Portfolio documents, version history, source traceability, approval status, open questions, and reconciliation of conflicting role or process statements.
- Support execution of the Portfolio Operating Model and Ways of Working by maintaining governance calendars, readiness checklists, artifact standards, and compliance evidence.
- Coordinate with the RTE, Deputy Portfolio Manager, TPMs, Mission Leads, Product, Architecture, Finance, Reporting, and delivery teams to connect governance records to roadmap and execution impacts.
- Maintain reporting readiness by validating source links, data-quality exceptions, metric definitions, and the traceability of executive statements to governed records.
- Identify recurring control breakdowns and support process improvements that reduce manual follow-up, duplicate reporting, delayed decisions, and unowned work .

What You Will Have:
- Project Administration: Knowledge of practices and tools used to administer complex projects, maintain records, track dependencies and completion dates, and ensure consistent execution of defined controls.
- Planning: Tactical and Strategic: Ability to connect near-term actions, forums, dependencies, and milestones to broader program and portfolio outcomes.
- Governance and Process Discipline: Ability to translate standards into practical operating routines, required evidence, clear ownership, review readiness, and closure.
- Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Ability to identify missing information, distinguish fact from assumption, frame unresolved decisions, and escalate material exceptions.
- Change Control: Knowledge of processes used to document, evaluate, approve, communicate, and trace changes to scope, dates, milestones, decisions, and commitments.
- Data and Reporting Quality: Ability to validate source lineage, identify missing or stale information, maintain shared definitions, and prevent unsupported conclusions from entering leadership reporting.
- Relationship Management: Ability to coordinate across technical, product, financial, business, and leadership stakeholders with professionalism, persistence, and sound judgment.

Top Candidates Will Have:
- Experience operating PMO, portfolio, program, governance, release, or project controls in a complex technical environment.
- Demonstrated strength maintaining decision, action, risk, dependency, change, and evidence records through closure.
- Ability to prepare and operate senior-leadership and cross-functional forums without turning governance into excessive bureaucracy.
- Working knowledge of Azure DevOps, Power BI, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, or comparable work-management and reporting tools.
- Strong attention to detail, follow-through, written communication, document control, and ability to challenge incomplete records constructively.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities, identify recurring process failures, and create simple, repeatable controls that reduce leadership burden.

jobs.title: 2027 Engineering Rotational Development Program (ERDP) -  Product Development Track
jobs.description:
Career Area:
Engineering
Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other.  We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Start Your Career with Purpose

Are you ready to apply your engineering education to real-world challenges? Caterpillar’s Engineering Rotational Development Program (ERDP) is designed for entry-level professionals like you. Through rotational assignments, you’ll continue developing your skills and knowledge—helping you achieve your career goals while contributing to Caterpillar’s mission of delivering exceptional products, services, and technologies to our customers. Our Engineering Rotational Development Program is an entry-level program designed to build employees’ skill sets within the discipline and continue growth, even after the successful completion of the program.

This 12 to 18-month program provides practical experience across multiple engineering teams and technologies. It’s more than just a job, it’s a launchpad for your future at one of the world’s leading manufacturers of construction and mining equipment.

What the Program Offers

As part of the ERDP, you’ll rotate through different teams and projects that match your skills, knowledge, and abilities. You’ll work on meaningful projects, connect with mentors, and get exposure to various areas of the company. Here are just a few paths you might explore:
- Product Design: Design components and systems for Caterpillar products to meet customer needs. Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the value chain—from concept to production—to deliver effective solutions.
- Simulation/Performance Analysis: Conduct analyses such as CFD [Computational Fluid Dynamics] (ANSYS), FEA [Finite Element Analysis], 3D modelling, system/subsystem/component design optimization, structural dynamics, development and optimization of engine, aftertreatment, battery, fuel cell, powertrain, and/or machine system performance.
- Test/Validation/Hands-on: Apply strong mechanical engineering understanding in a test/validation (hands-on) environment, troubleshooting issues, and collaborating with others for optimal results.
- Controls Development: Develop/implement control system algorithms using Matlab/Simulink for various control systems including, but not limited to, engine controllers, machine implement controllers, as well as powertrain controllers. Will be responsible for understanding the feature requirement, implementing it, as well as testing it prior to a production rollout.
- Electronic Components: Design and test various electronic control modules, as well as various electronic components. Work with various internal Caterpillar clients to understand controller/component requirements, help design PCB [Printed Circuit Board] layouts, as well as perform digital/analog/power circuit analysis and testing. Other duties may include working with suppliers, testing the controllers/components in various environments, ensuring that FMEAs [Failure Mode and Effects Analysis] are conducted and documented to meet stringent Caterpillar quality requirements.
- Embedded Software Development:  Develop embedded software in C, C#, and/or C++ for various electronic control modules. Some examples of embedded software development applications include Datalink communications, inputs and outputs (sensors and actuators), speed calculation, injection/spark timing, memory management, CPU optimization, multi-core design and implementation. In addition, some areas of work include developing scripts in Python/Visual Basic for automation.
- Software Validation/Verification for Electronic Systems:  Verify functionality of a feature or control system algorithm on a HIL [Hardware in the Loop] simulator bench or a SIL [Software in the Loop] system. Understand the requirements of the feature and/or the schematics of the controller/control system, verify functionality and debug/report anomalies to the development team, and help validate fixes.
- Engineering Data Analytics:  Write and understand computer code, Python, analytics/data science experience, apply machine learning concepts/tools, engineering and statistics fundamentals.
- Process Engineering: Apply mechanical, manufacturing, systems and/or industrial engineering knowledge to analyze and optimize an engineering process or processes. Leverage problem-solving and communication skills.
